name: OMTech FC-44 Intelli
tagline: Compact OMTech Intelli fiber: mid-size cutting/marking platform
tldr: OMTech FC-44 Intelli is a smaller fiber system than FC-105 for shops that need metal capability without full industrial footprint. Still a business machine: not a replacement for desktop diode or galvo fiber markers.
mainObjective: Mid-format fiber for metal-focused small businesses

priceRange.note: Official OMTech store, Oct 2026: listed at $56,999 (quote-based; 1.5 to 3 kW IPG source)

engraveExample.description: Filled logo on stainless steel plate

pros: Fiber cuts sheet metal: does not cut wood or acrylic
Software listed on the profile: test your workflow (LightBurn or maker app) on scrap first
Work area 1300 × 1300 mm (4 × 4 ft): confirm floor space, 3-phase power and loading before you order
cons: Does not cut wood, leather, or acrylic: sheet metal cutting only
Fume extraction still matters for coated metals and marking sprays
beginnerNotes: This profile covers OMTech FC-44 Intelli. Read the TL;DR and benchmarks before buying, then compare nearby models on the Compare page.
proTips: Run scrap tests first. Use this profile’s reference times for quotes, not marketing claims.
primaryUse: Mid-size fiber system for metal cutting and production marking.

editorialDepth.advantages: OMTech FC-44 Intelli is an industrial fiber cutter (1.5–3 kW IPG source, 1300 × 1300 mm bed) for steel, stainless and aluminum parts. It suits fabrication shops that want to bring sheet cutting in-house instead of outsourcing.
editorialDepth.limitations: Skip for engraving, wood, leather or acrylic, or without 3-phase 380 V power, assist gas and floor space for a multi-ton machine. Pricing is quote-based and installation is a project of its own.
